description: Library to monitor hardware components' energy consumption on all OSes
long_description:
Joular Core measures the energy or power consumption of hardware components:
CPU (Intel and AMD through RAPL on Linux and Windows, Raspberry Pi and other
boards through power models) and GPU (Nvidia through NVML, AMD through hwmon
sysfs or ADLX). It detects on its own what the machine offers, and also
provides a C interface so any language with a C FFI can use it.
